description_en: Adds IP entries to an access control policy group
description_zh: 在访问控制策略组中添加IP条目
kebab_example: aliyun slb add-access-control-list-entry --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --acl-id acl-bp1l0kk4gxce43kze00000 --acl-entrys entry_:_10.0.00.00/24_,_comment_:_privaterule1_,_entry_:_192.168.00.00/16_,_comment_:_privaterule2 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddAccessControlListEntry

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the access control policy group
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略组的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access control policy group
parameters.name: acl_id

parameters.help_en:
The access control policy group settings. Valid values:

entry: The IP entry to add to the access control policy group. You can specify CIDR blocks. Separate multiple CIDR blocks with commas (,).

comment: The description of the access control policy group.

You can add up to 50 entries at a time. If duplicate IP entries are added, only one entry is retained and the duplicate entries are ignored. IP entries must be CIDR blocks
parameters.help_zh:
设置访问控制策略组。取值：

entry：访问控制策略组中要添加的IP条目，可以指定IP地址段（CIDR block），多个IP地址段之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。

comment：访问控制策略组备注说明。

每次最多可添加50个条目，如果添加的IP条目重复，则只会添加一条，其余重复条目会被忽略。IP条目必须是IP地址段
parameters.name: acl_entrys
